mechanism: Retain one immutable selected R4 expert-table route per sparse layer, reuse its descriptor and resource leases on warm hits, and replace it only after a fail-closed device miss plus qualified fallback admission.

lifetime_model.routed_entries_in_snapshot: Only the last device-missed and host-admitted selected IDs.
lifetime_model.refresh_trigger: Nonzero device execution-position miss mask followed by successful qualified fallback.
lifetime_model.unsupported_route: Keep the prior bounded table; unsupported R0/native selections continue to miss and fall back.
lifetime_model.logical_lru_safety: Cloned Metal handles keep only the bounded selected-route resources alive after logical cache eviction.
lifetime_model.transient_refresh_bound: At most the old and replacement selected routes coexist while the replacement snapshot is built.

descriptor_residency.profiled_transfer_absence: No transfer record named device_expert_table_snapshot_upload on the stable single-token warm hit.

miss_and_refresh.cold_first_route: An empty routed table plus qualified shared lease guarantees a fail-closed miss.
miss_and_refresh.replacement_table_filter: All selected gate/up/down triplets must be exact R4 D32 direct-u8 with the shared triplet's geometry and byte extents.

synchronization_evidence.interpretation: One-route persistence preserves the router/expert merge on stable routes. A route sequence that changes every token is wait-neutral because every miss uses the guarded qualified fallback.

qualified: Stable selected R4 routes reuse immutable descriptor buffers and resource leases across tokens.
A profiled warm hit performs no descriptor table allocation or upload.
Persistent resources are bounded to one selected route plus shared per layer rather than every cache-resident expert.
Miss refresh preserves exact device decisions, Numeric Parity V2.1, and fail-closed residual semantics.
Changing routes add no waits relative to the qualified sequential expert wave.
not_qualified: One-route persistence does not accelerate a layer whose selected set changes every token.
A small multi-route associative table has not been admitted or measured.
R0 bits7 and native-bf16 indirect projection kernels remain unavailable.
The sealed Math-Preserve artifact and sustained 2K/8K/32K gates remain blocked by MOP clearance.
No flagship latency, TPS, memory-pressure, swap, or thermal promotion is claimed.
qualification.next_boundary: Measure route-set reuse on the sealed artifact after clearance; if reuse warrants it, admit a strictly byte-bounded two-to-four-route associative lease per layer before adding indirect R0/native-bf16 kernels.
